instruction: Candid full shot photograph in an indoor playroom with a white wall and green turf floor. On the left, the girl with braided hair (R1) in an orange t-shirt and yellow cropped pants leans back, smiling. On the right, the boy with shaggy dark hair (R2) in a white t-shirt and brown pants leans forward, pulling a green rope to the right. They are engaged in a tug-of-war game, pulling the rope in opposite directions under bright, even indoor lighting.
